fields.label: Mode Name
fields.description: e.g. Cash on Delivery, eSewa, Bank Transfer

fields.label: Slug
fields.description: Stable id the storefront uses in form values and analytics, e.g. 'cash-on-delivery'. Separate from Mode Name so renaming the display name cannot invalidate a shopper's in-flight checkout selection.

fields.label: Is Online
fields.description: Unchecked for COD/manual modes. Checked for modes that need a gateway redirect/callback before the order can be confirmed.

fields.label: Gateway
fields.description: Which gateway handles this mode when Is Online is checked. eSewa is currently the only integrated gateway.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: One line shown under the method name at checkout, e.g. 'Pay our rider while delivering your product.'

fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Leave empty to use the storefront's bundled artwork for this slug. Upload as a public file - a private one 403s for guests mid-checkout.

fields.label: Gateway Config (JSON)
fields.description: Reserved for future per-mode gateway options. Credentials stay in SaathiMart Settings.
